title: Zero Trust Microsegmentation Guidance
quotation: Boundaries may be expressed through zones, routes, VLANs/VXLANs, security groups, labels, tags, Kubernetes network policies, host controls, hypervisor controls, firewalls, gateways, or other enforcement points. This model is often strongest for deterministic containment, local east-west control, regulatory boundaries, and OT/ICS zones and conduits.
